modalities.evidence: All MRI data were collected in a Bruker BioSpec 7 Tesla scanner
respiratory waveform was measured during all resting-state measurements
The animals' facial behavior was simultaneously recorded using an MRI-compatible video camera

output.population: 15 Budapest pigeons scanned for two days
output.summary: Resting-state and anatomical MRI of sleeping pigeons acquired at 7 Tesla, with simultaneous respiratory waveform recording and video of facial behavior, pupil size and eye position.
